name: fishball-amenities
description: Installs the optional Fishball amenities together: fishball-board, fishball-heartbeat, fishball-taskboard and fishball-consultant, each its own package.
//dependencies: The amenities, each its own package and DSH bundle (independently installable). DSH makes only a profile's direct dependencies bundles, so this umbrella inserts its members' rows in its own patch (as DSH's dsh-cua-bundle does); they resolve through these dependencies. fishball-shared is the members' bundled library, carried beside them so the bundled members resolve it.
//bundleDependencies: The members are bundled, as dsh-connector-amenities bundles its amenities, so the umbrella tarball carries them and an install (online or offline) fetches none of them from a registry. Each member is still its own package, released and installable on its own.
//dsh: The collection client supplies its summary and the heartbeat settings. The consultant client registers its own page for both installation modes.
